zh: 我们找个时间约出来喝杯咖啡吧。
en: We should {catch up|meet up|meet|get together|go out} for a coffee sometime.

zh: 我们以前每个周末都在海边一起玩。
en: We used to {hang out|hang around|hang|meet up} at the beach every weekend.

zh: 你跟室友们合得来吗？
en: Do you {get on with|get along with|like} your flatmates?

zh: 他们因为钱闹翻了，从那以后再没说过话。
en: They {fell out|argued|fought|split up|broke up|split} over money and haven't spoken since.

zh: 他们大吵了一架，但第二天就和好了。
en: They had a big argument but {made up} the next day.

zh: 我姐姐上个月和男朋友分手了。
en: My sister {broke up with|split up with|split with|dumped|left} her boyfriend last month.

zh: 我当时不在本地，只好谢绝了邀请。
en: I had to {turn down|decline|refuse|say no to|reject} the invitation because I was away.

zh: 他自己的派对，他居然迟到一个小时才出现。
en: He {showed up|turned up|arrived|came|rocked up} an hour late to his own party.

zh: 我在超市碰到了一位老同事。
en: I {bumped into|ran into|met|saw} an old workmate at the supermarket.

zh: 他们交往大概一年了。
en: They've been {going out|dating|together|seeing each other} for about a year.

zh: 周六你想来我家吃晚饭吗？
en: Do you want to {come over|come round|come around|come|pop over|pop round} for dinner on Saturday?

zh: 欢迎带个朋友一起来。
en: Feel free to {bring along|bring|invite} a friend.

zh: 我一直很敬佩我哥哥。
en: I've always {looked up to|admired|respected} my older brother.

zh: 没人来听我的演讲，我感到很失望。
en: I felt {let down|disappointed|gutted|sad|hurt|upset} when nobody came to my talk.

zh: 第一次约会她就被放鸽子了。
en: She got {stood up} on her first date.

zh: 他过了好一阵子才愿意敞开心扉谈自己的感受。
en: It took him a while to {open up|talk|speak} about his feelings.

zh: 朋友们一到，她就高兴起来了。
en: She {cheered up|perked up|brightened up|relaxed|smiled} as soon as her friends arrived.

zh: 大学毕业以后我们一直保持着联系。
en: We've {kept in touch|stayed in touch|kept in contact|stayed in contact|been friends} since university.

zh: 我们聊往事一直熬到凌晨两点。
en: We {stayed up|sat up|were up} until two talking about old times.

zh: 圣诞节全家人都会聚在一起。
en: The whole family {gets together|meets up|meets|comes together|catches up|gathers} at Christmas.
